SiteMetrics.title: SiteMetrics
SiteMetrics.description: Real-time landing page visitor counter and application click telemetry.

totalVisits.description: Cumulative count of visitor sessions arriving on the landing page.

sispermbgClicks.description: Cumulative clicks on the SISPERMBG application link.

statusGiziClicks.description: Cumulative clicks on the Status Gizi application link.

sopSistakolClicks.description: Cumulative clicks on the SOP SISTAKOL BGN application link.

giziSeimbangClicks.description: Cumulative clicks on the Aplikasi Gizi Seimbang link.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last recorded visit or click.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Public rating and feedback submitted by landing page visitors.

authorName.description: Display name of the visitor leaving feedback.

authorRole.description: Optional profession or organization of the visitor.

appTarget.description: Application or portal scope being reviewed.

authorUid.description: Authenticated user UID if signed in, or empty string for guest visitors.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was created.

MediaSlot.title: MediaSlot
MediaSlot.description: Precision cropped image and framing metadata for the hero portrait or an application card.

slotId.description: Identifier matching the document ID of the media slot.

imageDataUrl.description: Compact cropped image encoded as JPEG/WebP data URI.

zoom.description: Zoom factor applied during precision editing (0.5 to 3.0).

updatedBy.description: UID of the verified admin who published this image.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last photo update.

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Server-managed administrator role record keyed by user UID.

grantedAt.description: Timestamp when admin privilege was granted.

/site_metrics/{metricId}.description: Singleton counter document at /site_metrics/visitors tracking page visits and app clicks.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Public ratings and comments displayed to all visitors on the GiziSync landing page.

/media_slots/{slotId}.description: Published custom cropped photos for the hero portrait and the four application cards.

/admins/{uid}.description: RBAC lookup collection for elevated administrators.
